description: Encode an image (or any file) as Base64: a data URI, bare Base64, a CSS background-image rule, an HTML tag (with width/height), Markdown, or for SVG a URL-encoded data URI (usually ~30% smaller). Detects the type from the bytes and warns when the result is too big to inline (over 10 KB: slows pages; over 1 MB: use a normal file). Results longer than maxChars are written to a .txt file instead of being returned. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/image-to-base64/

as.description: What to return: dataUri (default), base64, css, html, markdown, or svgUri (SVG only).

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

maxChars.description: Longest text returned inline; longer results go to a file. Default 200000.

mimeType.description: Override the detected MIME type (e.g. image/svg+xml).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

name: image_to_base64
title: Image to Base64 / data URI
